_comment: Engine-owned smoke/regression scene (audit TEST-101 / #368). Play-mode coverage: the --smoke-test harness runs two Play -> Stop cycles over this scene (filename contains 'smoke_play') and then exits, so CI exercises OnEnterPlayMode/OnExitPlayMode, the scene snapshot save+restore, PhysX world create/destroy, and the exit-teardown ordering that #389 broke. DELIBERATELY carries no authored Spin / Transform Controller blocks: those systems live in TartarusGame.dll, so entering Play is the first thing to instantiate their entt registry storage (from DLL code) — exactly the condition that made #389 an access violation on shutdown. One Animator block (AnimationSystem is engine-side) exercises that path too. Engine primitives only; no external assets or absolute paths.
